# Tarams v1.9.0 - Table of Contents

> Phoenix request params validation library

## Pages

- [Tarams](https://tarams.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [Tarams](https://tarams.hexdocs.pm/Tarams.md): Params provide some helpers method to work with parameters

- [Tarams.Schema](https://tarams.hexdocs.pm/Tarams.Schema.md): This is only a specification to define a schema to use with `Tarams.Params.cast` and `Tarams.Contract.validate`
- [Tarams.Type](https://tarams.hexdocs.pm/Tarams.Type.md): Cast data to target type.
Much code of this module is borrowed from `Ecto.Type`

- [Tarams.Utils](https://tarams.hexdocs.pm/Tarams.Utils.md)
